description: I’ve known Brian Fitzpatrick for 20 years. As a Federal Prosecutor, Brian fought international terrorism and put drug dealers behind bars. I am voting Brian Fitzpatrick for Congress, because I know he will continue to work hard to protect us and keep us safe. I hope you will join me.
